Are you tired of Scary Baboons updates? Dont you just wanna play OG Scary Baboon again? Well this game is for you. It has OG Cosmetics such as the Tophat and Tie. As a trial moderator, this game is super fun to play with friends and to socialize with people. If you install this, i hope you have fun!

The moderators in OG Scary Baboon are very kind, helpful, and active in keeping the community safe and enjoyable for everyone. The game also has strong moderation, and hackers or players who break the rules are dealt with quickly to help keep the experience fair for everyone. Another thing that makes the game stand out is how creative the owner is. They put a lot of effort into organizing live events and making them entertaining and enjoyable for the community. Overall, OG Scary Baboon is a great game because of its friendly moderators, fair environment, creative owner, and well-organized live events.
